title: Read, write and give the place value of decimals to thousandths

lesson.title: Meet the Thousandths Place

steps.say: You already know how to read decimals like zero point two five, twenty-five hundredths. Today we add just one more spot to the right, so we can say what a number like zero point three seven five really means.

visual.caption: One more place to the right of hundredths

steps.say: Right after the tenths place and the hundredths place comes the thousandths place. So in three hundred seventy-five thousandths, the three is three tenths, the seven is seven hundredths, and the five is five thousandths. The place a digit sits in tells you how big it is.

Let us try a real one. A bottle of juice from the store holds three point four zero eight litres. We read it as three and four hundred eight thousandths. The four is in the tenths place, the zero is in the hundredths place, and the eight is in the thousandths place, so the eight is worth just eight thousandths.

Now here is the mistake I see a lot. If I ask you to write three thousandths, it is very tempting to write zero point three. But zero point three means three tenths, which is way bigger! Three thousandths needs the three to land in the third spot, so we hold its place with zeros and write zero point zero zero three.

visual.caption: Three thousandths: zeros hold the empty places

steps.say: So remember, count the places after the dot: first tenths, then hundredths, then thousandths. The spot a digit sits in is what gives it its value.

lesson.answer: After the decimal point, count tenths, hundredths, thousandths — the place a digit sits in tells you what it is worth.

practice.question: A bag of blueberries at the market in Kelowna has a mass of zero point four zero eight kilograms. Read this number out loud in words, then say what place the eight is in and what it is worth. Then write four thousandths of a kilogram as a decimal number.
practice.answer: Zero point four zero eight is read as four hundred eight thousandths. The eight is in the thousandths place and is worth eight thousandths. Four thousandths is written 0.004.
